title: Studies
intro: The frames that belong to no gallery but this one. Still lifes, a quiet room, a stag, and birds caught mid-air.
intro_cs: Snímky, které nepatří do žádné galerie kromě této. Zátiší, tichý pokoj, jelen a ptáci zachycení ve vzduchu.

images.alt: A still life of flowers, a bowl of oranges and a tabby cat on a white-covered table
Two rowing boats pulled up on a rocky shore, in black and white
Close-up of a stag with large antlers in a forest
A desk and chair seen through open blue shutters into a quiet room
Two gulls landing on a railing above a blurred street
Two Alpine choughs in flight above a glacier valley
